implementation.behavior: After existing exact-material constructor batches, merge eligible opaque stock MeshStandard siblings within the same animated pivot, preserving all triangles, UVs, transformed positions/inverse-transpose normals and Float32 per-piece linear diffuse/roughness/emissive-times-intensity/metalness. Reuse the already-qualified fitted-equipment flat PBR shader without changing fitted gear behavior.
implementation.restrictions: Constructor-owned immutable recipes only. No cross-pivot/directly animated leaf merge; no textures, material arrays, transparent pieces, vertex colors, custom callbacks/depth/distance/clipping, morphs, skins, partial draw ranges, interleaved attributes or unsupported matrices. Unknown pieces retain ordinary rendering. Factory shader material ownership requires WeakMap identity and unchanged compile/cache callbacks; cloned and foreign shaders remain excluded from actor instancing. Existing shear/normal/visibility/shadow/lifetime guards remain active.
implementation.scalarGeometryGroups: Three 0.181.2 WebGLRenderer projectObject uses geometry.groups only for material arrays; scalar material renders the complete geometry. Preserve those ignored groups as complete source triangles, allow merging, and retain the scalar two-box72-vertex regression. Array materials stay excluded.
